items.stem: ISO 9001 certification confirms that an organisation:

options.text: Operates a quality management system meeting the standard's requirements
options.rationale: Correct: ISO 9001 certifies the management system, not individual products.

options.text: Makes the highest-quality product in its market
options.rationale: The standard does not rank product quality.

options.text: Has zero defects in everything it produces
options.rationale: Certification does not guarantee zero defects.

options.text: Is legally required to exist to trade
options.rationale: ISO 9001 is voluntary, not a legal requirement.

items.explanation: Correct: ISO 9001 certifies the management system, not individual products.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO steps follow a detected nonconformity under ISO 9001? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Take action to correct and control the immediate issue
options.rationale: Correct: correction deals with the nonconformity itself.

options.text: Analyse the root cause and apply corrective action to prevent recurrence
options.rationale: Correct: corrective action addresses the cause, not just the symptom.

options.text: Hide the nonconformity from the next audit
Immediately seek re-certification regardless of the cause
options.rationale: Re-certification is unrelated to closing one nonconformity.

items.explanation: Correct: correction deals with the nonconformity itself.

items.stem: Risk-based thinking in ISO 9001 requires an organisation to:

options.text: Identify risks and opportunities that could affect conformity and act on them
options.rationale: Correct: the standard embeds proactive risk consideration throughout the QMS.

options.text: Maintain a separate, formal risk register in a fixed format
options.rationale: The standard does not mandate a specific risk-register format.

options.text: Eliminate all risk from every process
options.rationale: Eliminating all risk is neither possible nor required.

options.text: Ignore risk unless a customer complains
options.rationale: Risk-based thinking is proactive, not complaint-driven.

items.explanation: Correct: the standard embeds proactive risk consideration throughout the QMS.
